incident.description: A V8 real historical economics workflow was launched after the controlling authority had been reconciled fail-closed to canonical synthetic-only scope. General continuous-execution authorization was incorrectly treated as sufficient despite the scope-specific Owner Gate requirement.

root_cause: Boot/restart Fresh Read did not successfully carry the latest #377/#394 authority reconciliation into the execution decision before V8 workflow launch.
durable_prevention: Before any non-synthetic Keirin workflow creation, launch, rerun, or data access, Fresh Read canonical main KEIRIN_NOW.md and governance CURRENT_STATE_KEIRIN.json in addition to #394/#377/branch CURRENT.
A generic Owner instruction such as proceed/continue does not satisfy a scope-specific Owner Gate named in canonical Keirin governance.
When canonical main and branch continuity disagree on scope, canonical main authority wins and branch scientific work is limited to design/synthetic-only tasks.
No workflow that can touch real RESULT/PAYOUT or economics evidence may remain auto-triggerable while synthetic-only authority is active.
Unauthorized-run outputs, if produced, are preserved only as incident evidence and never admitted to scientific selection, calibration, validation, promotion, or economic claims.
next_owner_free_actions: Continue source-independent synthetic engineering and Digital Twin W0-W4 diagnostics only.
Prototype probability-object/calibration diagnostics against synthetic outcomes only, with no real RESULT/PAYOUT or economics claims.
Observe workflow run metadata only until terminal; do not retrieve its artifact or logs/results.
Maintain a separate explicit Owner Gate requirement for any future real economics/RESULT-PAYOUT scope expansion.
